hints.title: Identify Required Character Frequencies
hints.text: The target word requires specific letter counts: one b, one a, two l, two o, and one n.

hints.title: Calculate Limiting Ratios
hints.text: For characters needed twice like l and o, integer division by two indicates the maximum instances supported.

hints.title: Take the Minimum Across Requirements
hints.text: Find the minimum count across all five character constraints to determine complete instances.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of input string text
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Constructing strings explicitly wastes time and allocations compared to direct frequency division.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting five specific English characters requires constant auxiliary storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle double occurrence letters correctly using integer division.
